members.none: No dimmers added. Add dimmers before creating a group.

csr.failed: Search failed. Try again in a moment.

guide.title: Before you search
guide.setupFirst: Set up the device in the SG app on your phone first. Homey does not add new devices to the network.
guide.closeApp: Close the SG app on phones and tablets.
guide.near: Keep Homey close to a dimmer or device.
guide.password: The password is 1234 unless you changed it in the SG app.
guide.passwordAccount: The password is 1234 unless you changed it in the SG app. If you did, log in with your SG account in the app's settings.
guide.durationPill: The search usually takes less than a minute.

account.quiet: In your SG account, but did not answer: __devices__. Try again closer to them.

account.title: SG account
account.intro: Log in with your SG account to fetch the network password and the list of devices for your homes. Your SG password is not stored. The app keeps only the network password, the keys and the list.
account.unavailable: Logging in with an SG account is not part of this build.
account.forgetConfirm: Remove everything fetched from the SG account? The devices then use their own password or 1234.
account.forgotten: Forgotten. The devices use their own password or 1234.

error.login: SG did not accept the e-mail or the password.
error.missing: Enter the e-mail and the password.
error.network: Could not reach SG. Try again.
error.busy: Already fetching or asking the devices. Wait a moment.

keepConnected.label: Keep dimmers connected
keepConnected.hint: Faster control, and changes made at the wall switch appear immediately. Only works with first-generation LEDDim Smart (@NDxxxx). If you only have one such dimmer, the SG app on your phone cannot reach it while this setting is on. Turn it off before adding a new device in Homey, or the search may not find it.

signal.title: Signal to Homey
signal.hint: Shown under "Link" when you open a first-generation dimmer. "Direct" means the dimmer is connected to Homey. Other dimmers are reached through it. Weak signal? Move Homey closer to a dimmer.

otherDevice.title: Which SG devices are supported
otherDevice.rotary: First generation (@NDxxxx) is stable. Later generations, including TW, Master and 400 2-pole, are being tested.
otherDevice.pill: , including Micro, TW and Smart Pill ON-OFF: being tested.
otherDevice.thermostat: : being tested. Control from Homey is new, on by default, and can be turned off.
otherDevice.sg3: , the products with 3.0 in the name, is not supported yet.
otherDevice.other: Other SG devices, such as DIN, Push, Floor and Pill DALI, are not supported yet.
otherDevice.report: Something not working? Report it in the forum thread.

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.hint: Only enable when the developer asks. Turn it off before sending a diagnostics report.

log.hint: Shows the latest log lines. Bluetooth addresses and device names are hidden, but the log shows when lights are used. Send it as a private message to the developer in the forum, not in the thread.
log.copyManual: Text selected. Copy with Ctrl+C, or press and hold the text.
log.empty: The log is empty. Use the lights a little, and try again.
log.failed: Could not get the log. Try again in a moment.

device.notHeard: No contact with the dimmer. Wrong password or out of range?
device.waitingForStatus: Waiting for the dimmer's first status.
device.passwordWrong: Possibly wrong network password. Check settings.
device.fakeLeftOver: Test device from a development run. Nothing is sent. Delete it.
device.badMeshId: This device has no valid mesh id. Delete it and add it again.

notification.passwordWrong: Possibly wrong network password in SG LEDDim. Check Network Isolation in the SG app, or enter the correct password in the settings for each device.

thermostat.controlOff: Control from Homey is off for this thermostat. Turn it on in its settings.
thermostat.waitingForStatus: Waiting for the thermostat's first status.

fault.FFF: Floor sensor fault (FFF). Check the floor sensor.
fault.E1: No reading from the floor sensor (E1).
